A look at how much RAM you might need as a Linux gamer

I'm not 100% clued on up on how Linux manages RAM usage but I had to explain to a friend that Windows manages pretty much all of your ram in a kind of software table format meaning it doesn't necessarily need to have 8GB of physical ram in order use 8GB or to run a game that would list its minimum spec as 8GB of ram. Added to that if you have a relatively fast recent computer and or you have something like an SSD then Windows will effortlessly move data to and from the page file without anyone noticing it so his haswell i7 with 4gb of RAM and SATA3 SSD would run most games just fine with 4GB of RAM than if someone with a lower end i3, a mechanical HDD, and 4GB of RAM tried to do the same.

Its almost always going to be better if you have more physical ram but if you have to you can probably game and get by with less than 8GB if that was your systems only significant bottleneck.
